info.name: IRoute — Driver Empty Move Flow
info.description:
HOW TO USE THIS COLLECTION:
1. Set driver_phone, driver_password, tenant_id in collection variables.
2. Run Request 01 Login first.
3. Run Request 02 Dashboard — if current_empty_move exists movement_job_id is saved.
4. If no empty move exists: an empty move record must first be created 
   (typically via driver app On Call mode or admin desktop assignment).
   Then refresh dashboard to get movement_job_id.
5. Run steps 03 through 06 in order.
6. Cancel (Step 07) is only valid before Step 05 fires.
7. action_codes for empty move actions must be verified against 
   Action Master database rows where scope=On_Call and category=Empty_Move.
   The exact codes depend on your Action Master seed data from Prompt 1.

Complete empty move flow for driver between jobs.
Empty move = truck movement with no cargo, no booking.
Three reasons: Return, Maintenance, Repositioning.
job_type is 'movement' for all empty move calls.
Use {{base_url}} variable = http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/v1/mobile
Use {{access_token}} variable = filled by login.
Use {{movement_job_id}} variable = filled after dashboard call.

request.description:
STEP 1 — SAME LOGIN AS JOB FLOW.
Send email, password, tenant_id.
access_token is auto-saved.
Token key in response is data.access_token.
Use Authorization: Bearer {{access_token}} for all subsequent calls.
NOTE: Login field is 'email' not 'phone'.
Set driver_email in collection variables before running.

exec: pm.test("Login successful, token saved", function() { pm.expect(resp.status).to.eql(1); });
pm.test("Login FAILED — check credentials", function() { pm.expect(resp.status).to.eql(1); });

item.name: 02 — Dashboard (Check for Empty Move or On Call State)

request.description:
STEP 2 — CHECK DASHBOARD FOR CURRENT STATE.
If driver is between jobs (On Call mode) no active_job will appear.
Look at data.current_empty_move for any active empty move.
If current_empty_move exists save its job_id as movement_job_id.
Empty move job_type is 'movement' (not 'shipment').
If no empty move exists driver needs to start one via A_EMPTY_START action.
Dashboard shows driver mode: Job / On Call / Offline.

exec: pm.test("Empty move found, movement_job_id saved", function() { pm.expect(resp.data.current_empty_move.job_id).to.exist; });
pm.test("No current empty move — driver in On Call mode, ready to start new empty move", function() { pm.expect(true).to.be.true; });

request.description:
STEP 3 — GET DETAIL OF THE EMPTY MOVE RECORD.
URL uses job_type = 'movement' (hardcoded for empty moves).
Uses movement_job_id from dashboard response.
Response shows: movement reason, from/to location, current status.
Status will be Scheduled before start, In Progress during, Completed after.
No Booking or Shipment linked to this record.
No cargo, no client, no commercial obligation.
This is pure asset movement for fleet tracking.

STEP 4 — OPTIONAL: VIEW ACTION HISTORY FOR THIS MOVE.
Shows all actions fired on this empty move in reverse chronological order.
Useful for debugging or confirming what has already fired.
Can be called at any point during the empty move flow.

item.name: 05 — Execute Start Empty Move (Scheduled → In Progress)

request.description:
STEP 5 — DRIVER STARTS THE EMPTY MOVE.
NOTE: action_code for empty move start may be named differently.
Check Action Master in database for the exact code where:
  scope = On_Call AND category = Empty_Move AND sequence_number = 1
Replace A_EMPTY_START in URL with that exact code.
When this fires:
  Truck Movement Log status: Scheduled → In Progress
  Start Time is stamped
No Shipment is created (empty move has no cargo).
No Booking Item is involved.
GPS at departure is captured.
Three valid reasons for empty move:
  Return = truck returning to base after delivery
  Maintenance = truck going for service/repair
  Repositioning = truck moving between hubs for next job

item.name: 06 — Execute Complete Empty Move (In Progress → Completed)

request.description:
STEP 6 — DRIVER ARRIVES AT DESTINATION. EMPTY MOVE DONE.
NOTE: action_code for empty move complete may be named differently.
Check Action Master in database for the exact code where:
  scope = On_Call AND category = Empty_Move AND sequence_number = 2
Replace A_EMPTY_COMPLETE in URL with that exact code.
When this fires:
  Truck Movement Log status: In Progress → Completed
  End Time is stamped
The Movement Log row is now terminal — cannot be changed.
Driver returns to On Call mode ready for next assignment.
Fleet utilisation dashboard updates with distance and time.

item.name: 07 — Execute Cancel Empty Move (Optional — Before Start Only)

request.description:
OPTIONAL STEP — CANCEL BEFORE STARTING ONLY.
NOTE: action_code for empty move cancel may be named differently.
Check Action Master in database for the exact code where:
  scope = On_Call AND category = Empty_Move AND sequence_number = 3
Replace A_EMPTY_CANCEL in URL with that exact code.
IMPORTANT RULES:
  - Cancel is ONLY allowed when status is Scheduled.
  - Once In Progress cancel is NOT allowed.
  - Once Completed cancel is NOT allowed.
When cancelled:
  Movement Log status = Cancelled
  Row stays in storage for audit (never deleted)
  Row is excluded from all KPI calculations
Use this if the trip was planned but never happened.

request.description:
OPTIONAL — REPORT AN ISSUE DURING EMPTY MOVE.
shipment_id is null for empty moves (no shipment attached).
issue_type values: delay, vehicle_breakdown, customer_unavailable,
  payment_dispute, pod_issue, accident, route_blocked, other
severity values: low, medium, high, critical
vehicle_breakdown is the most common issue during empty moves.
This does NOT stop or cancel the empty move automatically.
Ops supervisor receives the report and follows up.
